lessons_used: sign_in, copy changes were consistently helpful, winning 4 out of 5 tests (+3.0% average after noise correction).
adoption, redesign changes were helpful in 3 out of 5 tests (+3.0% average after noise correction), while 2 showed no clear effect.
finish, new_screen changes failed to sustain early success, with later tests showing no clear effect or performing worse (-1.3% average).
home, notification, sign_in, hint, finish, hint, and adoption, layout changes consistently showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
home, new_flow, finish, redesign, and choose_path, copy changes resulted in no clear effect or worse performance across multiple tests.
Predictions were consistently too optimistic overall, and single-test categories provide thin evidence.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Access Copy
candidates.change: Displays explicit copy clarifying that signing into an existing account immediately restores saved pets and configuration state.
candidates.why: Support receives frequent complaints about pets missing or resetting after signing in (8 emails). Prior lessons show sign_in copy tests consistently win (+3.0% average).

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Restore Your Saved Pets
sign_in.body: Log into your existing account to instantly sync and restore all previously adopted pets and custom settings.
sign_in.hint: Using the same sign-in provider guarantees your pet data stays connected.

guard.reason: Valid copy update on sign-in screen that retains all required functionality and adheres to copy rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong support signal (8 emails) and sign_in copy changes consistently win (+3.0% avg).

candidates.title: Full Bleed Pet Showcase Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pet selection screen with a full-bleed visual showcase layout and interactive mascot previews.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 77.8% conversion rate with long completion times (median 89s / mean 1017s). Lessons show adoption redesigns delivered consistent +3.0% gains.

guard.reason: 'pick_friend.replace.pet_choices[0]': a mascot cannot do the pet_choices job (use ['animation', 'button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Two Column Path Option Layout
candidates.change: Re-architects the path selection screen using a balanced two-column side-by-side layout with structured choice cards.
candidates.why: The choose_path screen has significant mean duration (514s), suggesting users pause to compare options. Clear side-by-side positioning simplifies decision making.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Preview Flow
candidates.change: Introduces an interactive preview component flow on the pet selection screen allowing real-time pet behavior testing.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is 77.8% and users spend substantial time customizing. Interactive previews help confirm pet rendering before finalizing.

guard.reason: Valid addition of interactive preview components to the pick_friend screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High adoption drop-off, but introducing new flows historically underperforms.

candidates.title: Desktop Engine Initialization Checklist Info
candidates.change: Displays an interactive checklist showing progress for desktop display hooks, engine startup, and tray readiness.
candidates.why: Home waiting screen takes median 201s / mean 2336s, and support receives reports of pets failing to render on the desktop.

guard.reason: Valid update to the waiting screen retaining progress tracking for pet creation.

candidates.score_note: Long wait times and clear support issues match proven wait_info gains (+2.6%).

candidates.title: Split Layout Home Control Summary
candidates.change: Updates the home welcome screen layout to a split view highlighting key desktop shortcuts and pet control gestures.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails report confusion about how to control, hide, or interact with pets after completing onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your New Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop. Use tray shortcuts and right-click gestures to manage companion behavior anytime.

home_welcome.text: Right-click pet for interaction menu; Drag to relocate; Double-click to sleep

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: Pet Naming Certificate Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated pet naming screen right after customization before generating the adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Adoption has high drop-off and users reported issues with custom pet results looking wrong or failing. Adding a focused name confirmation step anchors pet identity.

new_pet_naming.headline: Give Your Pet a Name
new_pet_naming.body: Enter a name to print on your companion's official adoption record.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a pet naming screen to the onboarding sub-flow while preserving all required screens.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step, but adding new screens consistently harms conversion (-1.3% avg).

candidates.title: Account Privacy and Data Protection Copy
candidates.change: Adds explicit data privacy and account deletion copy directly on the sign-in authentication options.
candidates.why: Support logged 4 emails regarding account deletion and personal data privacy. Clear sign-in copy improves sign-in conversion and trust.

sign_in.headline: Secure & Private Companion Account
sign_in.body: Your data is strictly encrypted. You maintain full ownership and can request complete account and data deletion at any time in settings.
sign_in.hint: We never sell personal data or share your custom uploads.

guard.reason: Valid privacy copy update on sign-in screen compliant with all base rules.

candidates.score_note: Moderate support complaints; sign_in copy changes have a strong track record.

candidates.title: Centered App Story Introduction Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the app story intro screen into a focused centered layout with high-impact visual banners.
candidates.why: Choose path has an overall drop-off of 18.3% and a high mean duration (514s). A clean centered intro establishes clear context quickly.

intro_story.text: Meet your virtual companion living right on your desktop window system.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Overview Flow Reorder
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated desktop controls summary screen right before the final home introduction completion step.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is only 35.8% and post-onboarding support indicates users are confused about controlling desktop pets.

new_controls_guide.headline: Desktop Pet Controls Cheat-Sheet
new_controls_guide.body: Quick reference for managing desktop placement, visibility, and tray controls.

components.text: Click & Drag to move pet; Tray icon for preferences; Hide pet during fullscreen apps

guard.reason: Valid insertion of a desktop controls summary screen into the onboarding sequence.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 23%, but reordering/adding finish steps historically yields neutral or negative results.

home, wait_info changes proved helpful, winning 2 out of 4 tests (+2.9% average after noise correction), while 2 showed no clear effect.
finish, new_screen changes failed to sustain early success, with 3 out of 4 tests showing no clear effect or performing worse (-1.3% average).
home, new_flow, finish, redesign, and choose_path, copy changes consistently resulted in no clear effect or worse performance across multiple tests.
